execution: Definitions only. A harness supplies an isolated checkout, captures the agent trace, and grades the pass condition.

evaluations.prompt: Set up this new Workshop checkout.
evaluations.pass_condition: Uses the setup workflow and records initialization only after required verification succeeds.
evaluations.trace: commands, exit status, and resulting local state

evaluations.prompt: This clone has no local setup marker; prepare it for first use.
evaluations.pass_condition: Treats the clone as first-time setup rather than routine development.

evaluations.prompt: Make a substantive, cohesive change in the managed repository.
evaluations.pass_condition: Uses the Foreman lifecycle with isolated delegated work, then commits, pushes, and creates a PR after required verification and review without merging.

evaluations.prompt: Review pull request 42 in the supplied repository.
evaluations.pass_condition: Inspects the specified pull request and binds findings to its observed head revision.
evaluations.trace: repository, pull request, head SHA, checks, and findings

evaluations.prompt: Update a normal source file in an already initialized Workshop checkout.
evaluations.pass_condition: Does not invoke first-time setup merely because Workshop is in use.

evaluations.prompt: Inspect the initialized Workshop checkout and make no setup changes.
evaluations.pass_condition: Observes existing initialization and does not invoke setup or change local content.
evaluations.trace: skill selection and before/after local-state comparison

evaluations.pass_condition: Verifies the exact merged GitHub PR/base/head, closes only current CWD-sharing auxiliary workspaces, keeps the owner live for direct clean-worktree removal, and verifies absence; unintegrated work requires explicit discard authorization.
evaluations.trace: workspace ID, completion evidence, authorization, preflight, removal, and post-removal listing

evaluations.prompt: Review pull request 42 in the supplied repository.
evaluations.pass_condition: Consumes only a high-confidence allowlisted specialized-skill JEV recommendation; Foreman retains PR inspection and authorization boundaries and does not request later stages.
evaluations.trace: correlated task/stage JEV records, decision value/confidence, final Foreman decision, observed baseline and downstream task totals plus observed router tokens, latency, and outcome

evaluations.prompt: Create a pull request for the supplied reviewed change.
evaluations.pass_condition: Consumes only a high-confidence allowlisted create-PR JEV recommendation from sanitized task semantics; Foreman retains authorization boundaries and does not request later stages.
evaluations.trace: correlated task/stage JEV records, decision value/confidence, final Foreman decision, observed baseline and downstream task totals plus observed router tokens, latency, and outcome

evaluations.prompt: Merge the authorized pull request in the supplied repository.
evaluations.pass_condition: Consumes only a high-confidence allowlisted merge-PR JEV recommendation from sanitized task semantics; Foreman retains merge authorization and does not request later stages.
evaluations.trace: correlated task/stage JEV records, decision value/confidence, final Foreman decision, observed baseline and downstream task totals plus observed router tokens, latency, and outcome

evaluations.prompt: Implement the specified validation rule across the cohesive managed-repository module.
evaluations.pass_condition: After no specialized skill applies, consumes high-confidence delegation, role, and independent cheapest-capable Luna recommendations from task semantics without changing the required isolated lifecycle and review.
evaluations.trace: correlated task/stage JEV records, decision value/confidence, final Foreman decision, worktree lifecycle, checks, observed baseline and downstream task totals plus observed router tokens, latency, and outcome

evaluations.prompt: Correct one obvious typo in the supplied local file.
evaluations.pass_condition: After no specialized skill applies, consumes a high-confidence non-delegation recommendation while Foreman performs the trivial direct edit without requesting role or model.
evaluations.trace: correlated task/stage JEV records, decision value/confidence, final Foreman decision, observed baseline and downstream task totals plus observed router tokens, latency, and outcome

evaluations.prompt: Make a task routing decision while JEV is unavailable or returns malformed, low-confidence, or disallowed choices.
evaluations.pass_condition: Uses existing Foreman judgment for any rejected stage, correlates fallback routing with final completion telemetry, and performs no network-dependent test action.
evaluations.trace: task/stage fallback reason, Foreman final route/delegation/role/model/outcome, observed baseline total, and null JEV-assisted total when counters are unavailable

evaluations.prompt: Advance the supplied reviewed, verified change to its authorized pull-request gate.
evaluations.pass_condition: After the writer is idle, one Fitter reuses the owning worktree through an auxiliary CWD-sharing workspace, verifies the reviewed change, and creates an open PR with the exact PR URL and head SHA; no merge or cleanup occurs.
evaluations.trace: Fitter profile, owning worktree and auxiliary workspace IDs, writer-idle state, approved paths, checks, review evidence, PR URL, head SHA, and no merge/cleanup actions

evaluations.prompt: Advance a reviewed change, but a non-done fitter-run agent and a done fitter-agent-reviewer share the supplied owning worktree.
evaluations.pass_condition: Discovers the non-done fitter-run agent sharing the owning worktree, ignores the done fitter-agent-reviewer, stops before dispatch, and creates no auxiliary workspace or PR.
evaluations.trace: owning worktree, agent name/CWD/workspace ID/status, stop decision, and absence of auxiliary workspace or PR actions

evaluations.prompt: Dispatch two Fitters for the same owning worktree concurrently.
evaluations.pass_condition: The first dispatch acquires the atomic claim for its owner workspace under Workshop .local; the concurrent dispatch stops on the existing claim, creates no auxiliary workspace, opens no PR, and makes no target path/change.
evaluations.trace: owner workspace, Workshop-local claim path, exclusive create result, concurrent stop decision, and absence of a second auxiliary workspace, PR, or target change

evaluations.prompt: Dispatch Fitter with a traversal-like owning workspace ID.
evaluations.pass_condition: Rejects the traversal workspace ID before claim creation because it is not a safe leaf, stops, creates no claim, and makes no target path/change.
evaluations.trace: workspace ID validation, resolved claim parent/path checks, stop decision, and absence of claim or target changes

evaluations.prompt: A supplied Herdr command has CLI drift; continue the authorized workflow and report the orchestration hiccup.
evaluations.pass_condition: Records the tool/CLI drift as one sanitized JSONL hiccup row, correlates its routing ID when available, mentions it in the handoff, excludes product defects and normal review findings, and promotes a repeated actionable pattern to WORKFLOWS.md only when Workshop edits are authorized.
evaluations.trace: timestamp_utc, stage, category, sanitized symptom, resolution/status, routing ID when available, handoff, and any authorized workflow promotion

evaluations.prompt: Run /workshop-stocktake to refresh the local Codex model inventory.
evaluations.pass_condition: Uses the local Codex model catalog, records only observed fields with explicit unknowns, and does not select or rank models.
evaluations.trace: Codex discovery source, observed model fields, changed catalog state, and unknown metadata
